name: Grasp
description: Grasp brings the most exhaustive private-market database into Claude — 100m+ companies, 500k+ buyers and 500k+ deals, with data straight from the source. Run deal research end to end: build target, buyer and transaction lists; refine with structured research; analyse financials and ownership; query and export exhaustive data tables; and pull company profiles or decision-maker contacts. Move from a broad investment thesis to final insights — surfacing the opportunities no one else can.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Grasp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Grasp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.grasp-ai.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Grasp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grasp lists 16 MCP tools, including grasp_create_table, grasp_import_table, grasp_compose_table, grasp_update_table, grasp_add_research_column, grasp_read_docs, grasp_check_job_status, grasp_cancel_job, grasp_get_table, grasp_list_tables, grasp_get_table_rows, and grasp_query_table.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Grasp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Grasp in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Grasp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Grasp is developed by Grasp AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
